definitions.explanation: The top leader or representative of an organization, association, club, or committee. Distinct from 社長, which refers specifically to the president of a company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{会長|かいちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
{会長|かいちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開会|かいかい}→開会：04118_kaikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The chairman gave the opening address.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧PTA⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{会長|かいちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三年間|さんねんかん}→三年間：28861_sannenkan⟧⟦{務|つと}めた→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: She served as PTA president for three years.

notes:
Used for the head of associations, clubs, committees, and similar organizations — not for commercial companies, where ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧ is used instead. In large corporate groups, {会長|かいちょう} may refer to the chairman of the board, a position above ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会長|かいちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to assume the chairmanship
- {会長|かいちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧ — to serve as chairman
- {副|ふく}{会長|かいちょう} — vice president
- ⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧{会長|かいちょう} — honorary chairman
